exposure: implementation of an emergency cesarean section Rapid Response Team (RRT)
cohort: 103 patients who underwent emergency cesarean section (52 in the control group without RRT and 51 in the experimental group with RRT)
finding: The implementation of an emergency cesarean section RRT was associated with significantly shorter delivery intervals and improved neonatal Apgar scores.
mod_finding: Implementation of an emergency cesarean section Rapid Response Team improved delivery intervals for emergency cesarean section.
